title: Yong-In Martial Arts
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Master Jinsub Kim, our esteemed headmaster, is a former Korean national team member with an extensive martial arts background. A graduate from Yongin University, he spent three years instructing at the Police Academy in Ethiopia before moving to the US to fulfill his dream of opening a martial arts school. Successfully cultivating a thriving community in Cypress, CA, Yongin Martial Arts bravely expanded its reach.
